Fix them TOGETHER -- fixing one and re-running is how this wedge lasted 252 cycles. rc=-9 is almost certainly OOM (free memory or cut test parallelism), NOT a code bug; rc>0 means run that test at HEAD to find the regression. SUSPECTS (re-derived from the blocking test above -- NOT what was filed most recently): first-party modules that test imports: background/process_run_complete.py, background/suite_duration_watch.py.
